verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents real bulk capabilities. A case import API batch-creates many cases at once, batch filing sends many filings to FinCEN in one batch, multiple attachments can be bulk-uploaded to a case, and tables and case history can be exported in bulk. However, these are limited to creation, filing and export, with no evidence of bulk edit, reassign, close or disposition across many existing items. Missing for 10: bulk update/assign/close operations on existing cases or alerts, documented bulk-operation API reference (no OpenAPI spec found), independent or hands-on corroboration.
